author: Arnav
problem: Read eight integers S_1..S_8. Print Yes if they are in non-decreasing order, all between 100 and 675 inclusive, and all multiples of 25; otherwise No.
bug_description: Uses > 100 and < 675 instead of >= and <=, so values of exactly 100 or 675 are rejected.

comments.accurate: Checks the eight values are sorted, within 100 to 675 inclusive, and multiples of 25
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks the eight values are sorted, strictly between 100 and 675, and multiples of 25
comments.wrong_location: Range check verified; check sorted() compares the values as integers
